scope: Thirteen independent processes, same cold-start32 original fixed cases. All initial arrays and200 pre-intervention frames paired exactly. Closed-loop actor continues to react; finite action interventions do not certify task tracking, pure open-loop gains or globally linear dynamics.

report.scope: Independent-process cold start; pair initial arrays and all200 pre-intervention frames. Original evaluation prefix is not replayed, so identity to its trajectories is not claimed. Closed-loop actor remains active; actual intervention is recorded.
